config._comment_masking: Layer-1 PII masking. GR1 Appendix C used Kafka Connect MaskField/ReplaceField SMTs, which cannot address fields nested under the Debezium before/after envelope and therefore forced ExtractNewRecordState to run first -- which in turn destroys the envelope GR1 section 4.2 requires Bronze to preserve. Debezium's own connector-level masking has neither problem: it runs before the envelope is built, so it masks the before-image too. See docs/adr/0004-connector-native-masking.md.
config._comment_envelope: No ExtractNewRecordState here. Bronze stores the unmodified change envelope (op, before, after, source) per GR1 section 4.2; flattening happens in the Bronze-to-Silver step where the before-image has already been archived.
config._comment_types: decimal.handling.mode=string keeps DECIMAL(12,2) exact and human-readable instead of base64 bytes; Silver casts it back to decimal. time.precision.mode=connect avoids microsecond-int representations that Iceberg cannot map directly.
config._comment_converter: JSON rather than Avro -- see docs/adr/0005-json-converter.md. schemas.enable=false keeps the Debezium envelope (op/before/after/source) intact while dropping the per-message Connect schema block.
